title: KaizerCore
description: A Donut-Like or economy survival Server
body:
Welcome to KaizerCore
Hey everyone! If you are a fan of the unforgiving, action-packed gameplay of Donut SMP, KaizerCore is exactly what you're looking for.

We built this server because we love that fast-paced, chaotic environment where absolutely nothing is safe. We’ve combined Semi-Anarchy Survival with a heavily player-driven Economy and brutal, high-stakes Crystal PvP. There is no hand-holding here. You can raid, you can grind, and you can build a massive empire—if you can survive the target on your back.

To make things even more interesting, we run Proximity Voice Chat. Whether you are negotiating a tense trade, begging for your life, or trash-talking during a massive CPvP fight at spawn, voice chat takes the chaos to a whole new level.

🗡️ What to Expect
The "Donut" Vibe: Fast-paced, ruthless, and completely unforgiving. If you want to survive, you need to be smart and geared.

Semi-Anarchy: Very few rules. No grief protection, no massive restricted zones. Trust no one, and hide your base well.

Active Economy: Grind for gear, set up shops, and trade with other players. Money is power, and it’s entirely driven by the community.

CPvP Focused: Crystal PvP is the core of our combat culture. Gear up, drop down at spawn, and test your skills in massive fights.

Proximity Voice Chat: (Highly recommended!) We use the Simple Voice Chat mod. Form alliances, scheme, or just hear the panic when you ambush someone in the wild.

🌐 How to Join
IP: kaizercore.fun

Version: 1.20.x (Make sure to update this to your exact version!)

Grab the Voice Chat mod, log in, punch a tree, and get as far away from spawn as you can. Good luck out there!
